intent: Follow a small brook through stones and a narrow ravine, bounce beside its pools and emerge at a waterfall clearing. Expert redesign: brook jets and pulsing river lilies.

sections.name: The small woodland brook
sections.lesson: Hop the brook’s exposed roots. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.
